description: Use this when the user asks whether ChatGPT or Google's AI answers recommend their app, and who they name instead. How often ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews named the app for its questions, with a 95% range, its average position when named, which apps they named instead, and which sites they cited (including whether the app's own site or store listing was cited).
name: ai_visibility_report
title: AI visibility report
